name: Excelso (Colombia)

Full creamy body ("قوام كريمي ممتلئ") with caramel, brown sugar and almond-cream notes ("الكراميل والسكر البني وكريمة اللوز"), clear sweetness and a balanced, smooth acidity, per the roaster's own product description. Varietal, altitude and roast level not stated.

expected_description_en: Guatemalan lot grown at Finca Santa Clara in the Antigua Valley on the slopes of Volcán de Agua by fourth-generation producer Ricardo Zelaya. Washed process: cherries pulped, fermented, washed, and dried in African beds over roughly 21 days per the roaster. Varietal stated as "Caturra & Bourbon." Tasting notes as stated: nougat, plum, honey — described by the roaster as offering sweetness, clarity and balance. Suitable for filter coffee and espresso per the roaster; part of THE BARN's "Core Collection" and, at fetch time, its best-selling coffee (7 reviews, 86% five-star). No light/medium/dark roast word is stated on the page, so roast_level is left null.
